Long Beach, CA · Colorado Lagoon · Road · Mixed

C U Next Tuesday (Queercicles) is a road group ride in Long Beach, CA. It rolls every Tuesday at 8:00 am from Colorado Lagoon. Pace: moderate (one chili on the local ride list).

About the C U Next Tuesday (Queercicles) group ride

A Tuesday morning ride led by Laila of Queercicles, a queer cycling crew in Long Beach. Listed on the community-maintained Long Beach Bike Rides calendar with a moderate pace rating. Check Instagram for the week's route.
